Package oel.taskmanager

Class TaskManager

java.lang.Object
oel.taskmanager.TaskManager
public class TaskManager extends Object
Service class that owns all tasks and implements the business logic of the Task Management System (add, view, update, delete, change status). Tasks are stored in a LinkedHashMap keyed by ID, which gives O(1) lookup, update and deletion while preserving insertion order for display. Identifiers are generated sequentially and are never reused. This class has no dependency on Swing, so it can be tested without a GUI.
Author:
Muhammad Hassaan Rashid
